{
  "name": "glimt",
  "version": "0.5.0",
  "description": "A quiet side pane: what this session is doing now, its plan, its agents as a tree, and every other Claude Code session with theirs",
  "author": {
    "name": "Mark Medum Bundgaard",
    "url": "https://github.com/mmedum"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/mmedum/glimt",
  "repository": "https://github.com/mmedum/glimt",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "icon": "./.claude-plugin/icon.png",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/mmedum/glimt#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/mmedum/glimt/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/mmedum/glimt#privacy",
  "userConfig": {
    "notifications": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Notifications",
      "description": "Notify when a background session starts waiting for you, finishes or fails; only one glimt on the machine does",
      "default": true
    }
  },
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "mod",
    "pane",
    "agents",
    "subagents",
    "sessions",
    "tui"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts"
}
